packages
Traces to: tenet-1 "Facts come from code and git, never from a model guess" · tenet-2 "A background process nobody asked for must not outlive its editor" · tenet-3 "The map stays usable while you work" · tenet-4 "What you read and what your agents did stays on your machine"
Decisions in force (9):
  ! 0007 Stop the daemon after 30 idle minutes · tested · exceptions: 0008, 0009 · packages/daemon/src/cli.ts, packages/daemon/src/server.ts
      why: `mole daemon` stops itself after 30 minutes without a request (`--idle-minutes`, 0 = never). The lock and socket are removed on the way out. Indexing and editing are exceptions, decided in 0008 and 0009.
      ! code in packages/daemon/src/cli.ts changed since 53aafc6 (record last committed) (.mole/decisions/0007-idle-shutdown.md:8)
  ! 0008 Indexing never counts as idle · tested · packages/daemon/src/server.ts
      why: While a worker job (full index or file update) runs, the idle clock does not tick, however long the job takes; the clock restarts when the job is done. An exception to 0007: a large first index must not be killed half way.
      ! overrides 0007, which is yellow (scope_changed: code in packages/daemon/src/cli.ts changed since 53aafc6 (record last committed)) (.mole/decisions/0007-idle-shutdown.md:10)
  ! 0009 Editing counts as use · tested · packages/daemon/src/server.ts
      why: A file change seen by the watcher resets the idle clock, like a request does. An exception to 0007: a person typing in one file for an hour must not lose the map.
      ! overrides 0007, which is yellow (scope_changed: code in packages/daemon/src/cli.ts changed since 53aafc6 (record last committed)) (.mole/decisions/0007-idle-shutdown.md:10)
  ✓ 0010 TypeScript Compiler API + SQLite is the v1 engine · no test · packages/indexer/src/ts-engine.ts, packages/indexer/src/db.ts
      why: The index is built with the TypeScript Compiler API (type-checked calls, imports, definitions) and stored in SQLite (node:sqlite). scip is for CI and other languages, tree-sitter for structure only; CodeGraph is not a dependency.
  ! 0011 Notes are repo files in .mole/notes anchored to symbols · tested · packages/memory/src/notes.ts
      why: A note is a markdown file with YAML front matter under `.mole/notes/`, anchored to `path#Symbol` with the symbol's normalized-body hash, so it travels with the repo and turns stale when the code under it changes.
      ! code in packages/memory/src/notes.ts changed since 53aafc6 (record last committed) (.mole/decisions/0011-notes-anchored-to-symbols.md:8)
  ✓ 0012 The seen log stays local · tested · packages/memory/src/seen.ts
      why: What you looked at is written to `.mole/local/seen.jsonl`, which is gitignored and never leaves the machine.
  ! 0013 The CLI loads heavy modules only in the subcommand that needs them · no test · packages/daemon/src/cli.ts
      why: The TypeScript compiler, SQLite and git history load with `await import()` inside the subcommand. Loading all of them on every call made a 3-call CLI test exceed 5 s on a loaded machine.
      ! code in packages/daemon/src/cli.ts#main changed since 1c39a04 (record last committed) (.mole/decisions/0013-cli-loads-heavy-modules-lazily.md:8)
  ✓ 0014 Agent states are read-only over the harness transcripts · tested · packages/agentstate/src/sources.ts, packages/agentstate/src/langgraph.ts
      why: Hermes, Claude Code and Codex transcripts are opened read-only (SQLite readOnly, read-only file descriptors). Mole never writes into them; anything it derives goes to `.mole/local/`.
  ✓ 0015 Fixed role columns instead of ELK · tested · packages/layout/src/layout.ts
      why: The panel lays nodes out in fixed role columns (callers left, focus middle, callees right); a node that keeps its role keeps its row.
Who to ask: raymond

packages/daemon  (intent: .mole/intent/packages/daemon.md)
Purpose: One background process per repo that keeps the TypeScript index warm and answers map/impact requests for the editor, the CLI and the MCP server.
End state: Starts on first use, survives editor reloads, stops on its own when nobody uses it (0007 with the 0008/0009 exceptions).
Risk accepted: Accepted that a cold start after an idle stop costs one full index; not accepted that the map stops while someone types.
